recompose_pdp_gates.why: The judge flagged 2 blocking integration seams: a naive rebase would re-open P1 (raw variables/history/starter to any tenant member) and P2 (enumeration — total leaking the count of invisible instances). Both T-0721/T-0722 gates live in the two route blocks part A rewrote.
recompose_pdp_gates.LIST_gate_T0722_preserved: filterProjectionsByReadVisibility (dev) now runs FIRST — before the query pipeline AND before overlayDetailLiveSteps. selectProcessPage operates over the ALREADY PDP-narrowed `visibleProjections`, so {total} = |PDP-visible ∩ query-match|, never the raw tenant count. The enumeration side-channel T-0722 closed stays closed under pagination: a hidden instance can neither appear in instances[] NOR be counted in total. overlay input is drawn from visibleProjections, so a hidden instance never reaches the engine layer either.
recompose_pdp_gates.DETAIL_gate_T0721_preserved: The T-0721 `if (detailVisible)` wrapper is kept AROUND my starter-fold. The starter name resolves in the SAME single batch as the history completers (T-0648 one-call invariant), but that whole body — starter resolve included — executes ONLY when detailVisible; a PDP-hidden instance gets honest-404 and resolves/emits nothing (no raw variables/history/completedBy/starter leak).

known_nits_not_fixed.F3_total_fold_window: total is bounded by the ≤500 fold window (readEvents cap in listInstanceProjections) — a tenant with >500 instances reports total capped at what the fold saw. This is a PRE-EXISTING cap (the projection has always folded ≤500), NOT introduced by this task, and left as-is per the coordinator: the projection is an audit fold, not a paginated SQL table; deep-history pagination is a separate concern (ADR rejected-alternatives). Documented, not fixed.

live_proof_plan.note: Stand offline at handoff. Plan to run once the dev stack (Tailscale 100.121.76.86:3000, PG :55432, Keycloak :8180, Flowable) is back, as a rank-and-file (non-owner) per D-064.
setup: Have a tenant with >25 real process instances across ≥2 definitions and ≥2 starters (start several via record on_create + explicit launch, by two different employees).
Log in as a rank-and-file employee WITHOUT constructor grants (the anti-case persona).
steps: 1. GET /api/processes (no params) → 200, body has {instances,total,limit,offset}; total = real instance count; instances.length = min(total,200); order = newest-first (startedAt DESC), ties by id.
2. GET /api/processes?limit=10&offset=0 then ?offset=10 → two disjoint pages, total constant, no row repeats across pages, deterministic order.
3. GET /api/processes?definition=<procKey> → only that definition's instances (total drops); ?status=running → only running; both compose with ?q=.
4. GET /api/processes?q=<substring of a source record's title / definition name> → the operator finds their instance by human text, никогда не по UUID (anti-case).
5. GET /api/processes?started_from=<iso>&started_to=<iso> → only instances started in the window; an instance outside is absent.
6. As employee X: GET /api/processes?mine=1 → only instances X started; as employee Y the same query returns Y's set (no cross-leak — FF-5).
7. GET /api/processes/<instanceId> → detail carries starterName + starterType (человеко-имя, not just a glyph); resolver called exactly once for the request (union of history completers + starter).
8. Negative: ?definition=<foreign-tenant procKey> and ?record=<foreign record> → honest-empty, never another tenant's rows.
9. Regression: an existing consumer (current /processes table) still renders — default limit 200 returns the full set for tenants ≤200 instances.
expected_red_flags_to_watch: starterName absent for all rows → resolveActorsDisplay not wired in server.ts composition root (best-effort degrade is acceptable, but investigate).
total not matching a manual count → fold window (≤500) exceeded; document/raise the window bound.
pagination showing duplicates across pages → sort not total (should be impossible given the id tiebreak; would indicate a data id collision).

risks_integration: PDP composition (was the judge's blocking concern, now closed): the T-0722 read-visibility filter runs BEFORE the query pipeline and BEFORE overlay, so total is post-PDP and enumeration stays closed under pagination; the T-0721 detail gate wraps the starter-fold so nothing leaks for a hidden instance. Proven by 4 FF-INST-VIS gates + a live-PG composition test (see recompose_pdp_gates).
Interim UI: until T-0654-b ships, the current dumb /processes table calls GET /api/processes with no pagination params → default limit=200 (unchanged for tenants ≤200 instances).
Fold window (F3, known/pre-existing — see known_nits_not_fixed): filtering/pagination/total operate over the last ≤500 instances (readEvents cap). Not introduced here; not fixed per coordinator.
starterName is best-effort (T-0648 resolver): no resolver / unresolved actor / no-DB path → field simply absent; the frontend must fall back to starterType/starterId (never render a raw UUID).
listInstanceProjections is called with {limit:500} on the list path (was default 200) — widens the fold window; additive, no behavioral regression.
